cohort: 616 Syrian refugee women and 644 Jordanian women giving birth at two governmental hospitals in northern Jordan between January 1, 2014 and December 31, 2014
finding: Syrian refugee mothers had a significantly higher rate of Caesarean section, anaemia, lower neonate weight, and lower APGAR scores compared to Jordanian mothers.
birth_weight: Neonates' weight measured, with Syrian refugees having lower birth weight
